XIAO_TU_CARD_STRIKE_XIAO_TU.title: Strike
XIAO_TU_CARD_DEFEND_XIAO_TU.title: Defend
XIAO_TU_CARD_RUSTY_DICE.title: Rusty Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_RUSTY_DICE.description: Gain 1 die; this card costs 1 more this combat. Upgraded: also reroll all dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_STRIKE.title: Lucky Strike
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_STRIKE.description: Reroll 1 random die. Deal {Damage:diff()} plus that die's value damage.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_DEFEND.title: Lucky Defend
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_DEFEND.description: Reroll 1 random die. Gain {Block:diff()} plus that die's value [gold]Block[/gold].
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_BARRAGE.title: Dice Barrage
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_BARRAGE.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies ({CalculationBase:diff()} + total dice).
XIAO_TU_CARD_PLASTIC_DICE.title: Plastic Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_PLASTIC_DICE.description: Gain 2 temporary dice, then reroll all dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LEAD_DICE.title: Loaded Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_IS_RIGHT.title: Even Steven
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_IS_RIGHT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy, plus 1 extra hit for each even die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_IS_RIGHT.title: Odd Todd
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_IS_RIGHT.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus 1 extra time for each odd die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_HASTY_BITE.title: Hasty Bite
XIAO_TU_CARD_HASTY_BITE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Reroll 1 random die and bet high; if it succeeds, gain 1 Strength.
XIAO_TU_CARD_NIMBLE_HARE.title: Nimble Hare
XIAO_TU_CARD_NIMBLE_HARE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Reroll 1 random die and bet high; if it succeeds, gain 1 Dexterity.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_DRAW_MIRACLE.title: Single Pull Miracle
XIAO_TU_CARD_EXCHANGE_CHIPS.title: Exchange Chips
XIAO_TU_CARD_EXCHANGE_CHIPS.description: Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy. Reroll 1 random die and bet high; if it succeeds, draw 1 card. Upgraded: rerolls the lowest die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_NO_BEATING.title: Promise Not To Hit
XIAO_TU_CARD_NO_BEATING.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Pledge 1 die for 3 turns.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LET_YOU_HIT.title: Promise You Can Hit Me
XIAO_TU_CARD_ALL_IN.title: Cash Out
XIAO_TU_CARD_ALL_IN.description: Pledge all dice for 3 turns (2 upgraded). Draw 2 cards for each die pledged.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORCED_LIQUIDATION.title: Margin Call
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORCED_LIQUIDATION.descript: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies ({CalculationBase:diff()} + total dice before pledging). Pledge all dice for 3 turns (2 upgraded).
XIAO_TU_CARD_DEAD_PLEDGE.title: Forfeit
XIAO_TU_CARD_DEAD_PLEDGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Pledge 2 dice for 99 turns (1 upgraded).
XIAO_TU_CARD_IRON_SLASH.title: Iron Wave Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_IRON_SLASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Reroll 1 random die and bet high; if it succeeds, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold]. Upgraded: rerolls the lowest die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_BOOST.title: Lucky Boost
XIAO_TU_CARD_ADD_STAKE.title: Raise!
XIAO_TU_CARD_ADD_STAKE.description: Lose {Gold} gold. Gain 1 temporary die. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
XIAO_TU_CARD_MORE_STAKE.title: Raise Again!!
XIAO_TU_CARD_MORE_STAKE.description: Lose {Gold} gold. Gain temporary dice up to the limit, then reroll all dice. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAY_TO_WIN.title: Pay2Win
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAY_TO_WIN.description: Reroll all dice. Lose {Gold} gold. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SPARE_ME.title: Spare Me
XIAO_TU_CARD_GRAND_SALE.title: Grand Sale
XIAO_TU_CARD_GRAND_SALE.description: Gain {Gold:diff()} x total dice gold. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GOLDEN_DICE.title: Golden Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_TIP_PLEASE.title: Tip Please
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_STRIKE.title: Dice Strike
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_GUARD.title: Dice Guard
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAIR_UP.title: Pair
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAIR_UP.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If any dice share a value, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_ROLL.title: Odd Roll
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_CLIMB.title: Even Climb
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_CLIMB.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Reroll all even dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_PRESS_ADVANTAGE.title: Press the Advantage
XIAO_TU_CARD_PRESS_ADVANTAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Reroll 1 random die and bet high; if it succeeds, deal damage again.
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRY_ROLL.title: Test Roll
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRY_ROLL.description: Reroll {Amount:diff()} random dice. Draw 1 card. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_TEMPORARY_CUSTODY.title: Temporary Custody
XIAO_TU_CARD_TEMPORARY_CUSTODY.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Pledge 1 die for 2 turns.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SELL_DICE.title: Sell Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_SELL_DICE.description: Pledge 1 die for 99 turns. Gain {Gold} gold. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_ALL.title: Odds and Evens
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_ALL.description: For each odd die gain {Amount:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. For each even die deal {Amount:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
XIAO_TU_CARD_MAKE_IT_EVEN.title: Make It Even
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLUSH.title: Flush
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLUSH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If all dice share parity, draw cards equal to the number of dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_REVERSAL.title: Reversal of Fortune
XIAO_TU_CARD_STRAIGHT.title: Straight
XIAO_TU_CARD_STRAIGHT.description: If you have 3 or more dice in a run, gain 2 Energy, draw {Cards:diff()} cards, then reroll all dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_GAMBLE.title: Last Gamble
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_GAMBLE.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Reduced by 3 (4 upgraded) for each die you have.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FOLLOW_THE_CROWD.title: Follow the Crowd
XIAO_TU_CARD_FOLLOW_THE_CROWD.descriptio: Reroll all dice, then the lowest die becomes equal to the highest.
XIAO_TU_CARD_WISH_COME_TRUE.title: Wishes Come True
XIAO_TU_CARD_SIX_SIX_SIX.description: Reroll 1 random non-6 die, 3 times. Upgraded: reroll all non-6 dice each time.
XIAO_TU_CARD_CACTUS_DICE.title: Cactus Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_CACTUS_DICE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain 1 temporary die and Thorns equal to its value.
XIAO_TU_CARD_METEOR_DICE.title: Meteor Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_METEOR_DICE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain 1 temporary die and apply Vulnerable equal to its value.
XIAO_TU_CARD_STONE_DICE.title: Stone Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_BENEFIT.title: Odd Perks
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_BENEFIT.description: At the end of your turn, gain {Amount:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each odd die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_CHOSEN_ONE.title: Chosen One
XIAO_TU_CARD_CHOSEN_ONE.description: At the start of each turn, your lowest die is rerolled once more.
XIAO_TU_CARD_CONSOLATION_PRIZE.title: Consolation Prize
XIAO_TU_CARD_CONSOLATION_PRIZE.descripti: Whenever a die is rerolled, gain {Amount:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLYING_DICE.title: Flying Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLYING_DICE.description: Whenever a die is rerolled, deal {Amount:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
XIAO_TU_CARD_HANDLING_FEE.title: Handling Fee
XIAO_TU_CARD_HANDLING_FEE.description: Whenever a die is rerolled, gain {Amount:diff()} gold.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SHOW_HAND.title: Show Hand
XIAO_TU_CARD_SHOW_HAND.description: Lose all gold. For the rest of combat, attack damage +({Amount:diff()} + gold/2)%. Does nothing when gold is not positive.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORTUNE_AND_MISFORTUNE.desc: Whenever you lose gold, deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
XIAO_TU_CARD_REBATE.title: Rebate
XIAO_TU_CARD_REBATE.description: Gold you lose to effects this combat is refunded at {Amount:diff()}% on victory.
XIAO_TU_CARD_WEALTHY.title: Filthy Rich
XIAO_TU_CARD_WEALTHY.description: For every 100 gold you have, attacks deal 1 more damage (up to +{Amount}). No bonus while in debt.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORTUNE_SHIELD.title: Fortune Shield
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORTUNE_SHIELD.description: Reduce attack damage you take by your lowest die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_OPENING_THUNDER.title: Opening Thunder
XIAO_TU_CARD_OPENING_THUNDER.description: Innate. Gain temporary dice up to the limit. Deal total dice x number of dice sharing a value with another die damage (now {CalculatedDamage:diff()}).
XIAO_TU_CARD_SWAP.title: Swap
XIAO_TU_CARD_SWAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add {Amount:diff()} Fake Dice to your draw pile.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FISH_EYE.title: Pass Off
XIAO_TU_CARD_FISH_EYE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add 1 Imitation Die to your draw pile.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FAKE_DICE.title: Fake Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_FAKE_DICE.description: Gain 1 temporary die. Draw 1 card. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_IMITATION_DICE.title: Imitation Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_WEAK_GIRL.title: Weak Girl
XIAO_TU_CARD_WEAK_GIRL.description: Lose all dice slots this combat. Gain 5 Strength and 5 Dexterity. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_FROM_SCRATCH.title: Start Over
XIAO_TU_CARD_FROM_SCRATCH.description: Your rerolled dice always land higher than before; a 6 becomes 1.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GAMBLER_FORM.title: Gambler Form
XIAO_TU_CARD_GAMBLER_FORM.description: Your dice are at least {Amount:diff()}. Gain 1 die, then reroll all dice.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SCHRODINGER.title: Schrodinger's Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_SCHRODINGER.description: All your dice count as both odd and even.
XIAO_TU_CARD_NOT_COUNTING.title: Does Not Count
XIAO_TU_CARD_NOT_COUNTING.description: When a die rolls 1, it is rerolled automatically.
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAWN_SHOP.title: Pawn Shop
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAWN_SHOP.description: Whenever you pledge a die, gain {Amount:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
XIAO_TU_CARD_WIN_STREAK.title: Winning Streak
XIAO_TU_CARD_WIN_STREAK.description: Every 2 consecutive successful bets, gain 1 Energy. A failed bet resets the streak.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GAMBLE_LOSER.title: Good Sport
XIAO_TU_CARD_GAMBLE_LOSER.description: Whenever you play an Attack, reroll and bet high on a random die. On success apply 1 Vulnerable to the target before damage; on failure gain 1 Weak. Upgraded: uses the lowest die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_BOTH_WAYS.title: Both Ways
XIAO_TU_CARD_BOTH_WAYS.description: Your first Skill each turn is played twice if you have at least one odd and one even die. Upgraded: also Attacks.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SIT_AND_KILL.title: Table Master
XIAO_TU_CARD_SIT_AND_KILL.description: While you have 3 dice of the same value, you take no attack damage. Each time you are attacked, reroll a random die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GUARANTEE.title: Floor Guarantee
XIAO_TU_CARD_GUARANTEE.description: When you deal attack damage, the enemy loses at least HP equal to your lowest die. Upgraded: also rerolls that die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_BANKROLL.title: Bankroll
XIAO_TU_CARD_BANKROLL.description: When you take attack damage, reduce it by up to {Amount:diff()} and lose that much gold. Stops at -1000 gold.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GILDING.title: Gilding
XIAO_TU_CARD_GILDING.description: For every 15 gold you lose to effects, upgrade a random card in your draw pile. Innate when upgraded.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LET_GO.title: Let Go
XIAO_TU_CARD_LET_GO.description: Lose {Amount:diff()} dice slots this combat. At the end of combat, gain an extra card reward.
XIAO_TU_CARD_OLD_GEEZER.title: Old Geezer
XIAO_TU_CARD_OLD_GEEZER.description: At the end of combat, gain {Amount:diff()} extra gold reward(s).
XIAO_TU_CARD_BORROW_DICE.title: Borrowed Dice
XIAO_TU_CARD_BORROW_DICE.description: This turn, temporary dice you gain last 1 extra turn and are lowered by {Amount:diff()} (min 1).
XIAO_TU_CARD_MIRACLE_DICE.title: Miracle Die
XIAO_TU_CARD_MIRACLE_DICE.description: Gain 1 die this combat that is locked at 6 and immune to any effect that changes its value.
XIAO_TU_CARD_COMPOUND_INTEREST.title: Compound Interest
XIAO_TU_CARD_COMPOUND_INTEREST.descripti: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For every time you pledged or gained a die this combat (including the automatic turn-start rolls), +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage.
XIAO_TU_CARD_CUP_WORLD.title: World in a Cup
XIAO_TU_CARD_CUP_WORLD.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each die rerolled this turn, +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage.
XIAO_TU_CARD_ANOTHER_ROUND.title: One More Round
XIAO_TU_CARD_ANOTHER_ROUND.description: Reroll all dice. Shuffle all cards into your draw pile, Exhaust all Status cards in it, then draw 5 cards. Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GO_EASY.title: Go Easy On Me
XIAO_TU_CARD_GO_EASY.description: Apply 1 Weak and 2 Mangle to an enemy. Lose {Gold:diff()} gold. Returns to your hand when played.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LEEK_MARK.title: Mark
XIAO_TU_CARD_LEEK_MARK.description: Mark an enemy: whenever it takes damage, you gain 1 gold.
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_SWITCH.title: Odd Becomes Even
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_SWITCH.description: If total dice is odd: Transform a card in your hand. If even: Exhaust a card in your hand. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
XIAO_TU_CARD_GODDESS_LUO.title: Goddess?
XIAO_TU_CARD_GODDESS_LUO.description: Reroll your lowest die; if it isn't 6, play this card again (up to 6 times; no limit upgraded). Exhaust.
XIAO_TU_CARD_SET_UP.title: Set Up
XIAO_TU_CARD_SET_UP.description: Reroll 1 random die and bet high. On success apply 1 Vulnerable, 1 Frail and 1 Mangle to ALL enemies; on failure only one of them at random. Upgraded: uses the lowest die.
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRICK_DICE.title: Dice Trick
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRICK_DICE.description: Pledge 1 die for 2 turns (real dice first). When it returns, also gain a copy with the same value.
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_PLEDGE.title: Final Roll
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_PLEDGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and pledge 1 die for 2 turns. If it was your last die, also apply 3 Vulnerable.
XIAO_TU_CARD_PUNISHMENT_DRINK.title: Drink Up
XIAO_TU_CARD_PUNISHMENT_DRINK.descriptio: On your next turn you can play only one card. At the end of combat, obtain a Champagne. Exhaust.
